name: M3b - Decision gateway
description: Reply / Hold buttons from every channel land here. State in ops.approvals; one branded page for every outcome.

parameters.content:
## Decision gateway
Every Reply / Hold button in every channel (email card, digest, Teams, WhatsApp) lands here with ?t=token&d=approve|hold. State lives in ops.approvals (Supabase), not in a paused execution: one atomic transition per click, the outcome decides what the page says, a change of mind from hold to reply just works, and a dead link is a branded page rather than an n8n error.

nodeGroups.name: After the page
nodeGroups.description: Runs after the browser has its page: reply path sends the acknowledgement and logs sent; a fresh hold logs held
